item.title: Not sure what I REALLY should do when I grow up
item.description: Do what you really want to do but do it good. There is no assured path anymore so there is no point in choosing a ‘‘safe’’ route. I chose the ‘‘safe’’ route but it didn’t pay any more than if I had done what I really wanted. Also learn to ignore everyone around you, this is your own adventure. If you do what you really feel like doing, it will be a lot easier to do it well and you will have gained something constructive for yourself by giving it all you had.
